newsitem.title: POLAND: WOOD SECURITIES UNDERWRITE JUTRZENKA ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: WOOD SECURITIES UNDERWRITE JUTRZENKA ISSUE.

text.p: Dutch Wood Securities B.V. underwrote one million shares of Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA's new issue, Jutrzenka said in a Tuesday statement.
It said Wood Securities would purchase the shares at 67 zlotys if the main market's WIG index is above 13,200 points and at 55 zlotys if WIG is below that level.
It said the stand-by fee was six percent of the value of the shares.
It was not immediately clear whether Wood Securities underwrote the whole issue, as Jutrzenka has not yet said how many new shares it planned to float.
The issue has yet to be approved by Jutrzenka's extraordinary general shareholders meeting on December 7.
